name: Pontevedra (Spain)
description: White field with blue triangles at the hoist and the fly forming a diabolo, charged at the centre with the crowned arms of Pontevedra (a bridge above waves on blue).
history: The flag is formed of a blue diabolo, the rest of the flag being white, with the arms of the city in the middle; it can be seen on all buildings of the municipal administration of the city.
